# laravelforge_redirect_rule (Resource)

Manages a redirect rule on a Laravel Forge site. Redirect rules have no update endpoint, so any change to `from`, `to`, or `type` forces replacement.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `from` (String) Source URL path. Create-only.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the site belongs to.
- `site_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the site to create the redirect rule on.
- `to` (String) Destination URL path. Create-only.
- `type` (String) Redirect type (`redirect` or `permanent`). Create-only.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the redirect rule.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status (`installing`, `installed`, or `removing`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
